title: Façade banner sequence
slide_intent: Show how repetition links different exhibitions, because a passerby should recognize the institution before reading each programme.
strategic_value: Alternating large names and MoMA signatures can give a changing exhibition programme a stable public presence.
demonstration: A façade carries a row of narrow banners combining large artist names, black MoMA lettering and colored fields.
practical_value: Compare recognition across a sequence rather than judging each banner in isolation.

content_islands.name: Banner row
content_islands.spec: Place the alternating exhibition names and MoMA signatures across the upper wall; retain their vertical orientation and contrasting color fields.

content_islands.name: Architectural context
content_islands.spec: Keep the surrounding façade visible so the scale and mounting of the sequence remain apparent.

reference_purposes.Expression: Large alternating names, colored fields and black signatures create a repeated visual rhythm.
reference_purposes.Application: The identity appears as a multi-banner installation on the museum exterior.
